fixes.what: Report the effective sample size (1/sum w^2) and bootstrap/seed-to-seed spread for every reweighted P(Tk<=30) and T50; drop or flag rows with ESS < ~100. Rerun the 'both' case with an importance-sampling-friendly route (rerun nested sampling with the 12C+13C likelihood included, or add the 1-0 ratios to the likelihood in q50_dyn.py) instead of reweighting 0.3% of the mass.
fixes.why: Zfac 0.002-0.015 means a few tens of effective samples; the reported 0.39-0.60 is within noise of the 0.18-0.70 scatter in the CSV.
fixes.how_experts_do_it: Include all constraints in the nested-sampling likelihood and report evidence ratio and posterior quantiles from >=3 seeds; quote ESS for any reweighting.

fixes.what: Redo the (a) limit using only chi2-acceptable wing models (chi2/dof ~1, e.g. log-quadratic/log-cubic/exp in the 341.80-342.20 window), and state the alpha limit as a single number with the model-selection step (AIC/BIC) shown; handle the grid floor at -0.05 (extend the alpha grid to negative values or fix alpha>=0 with a proper bound).
fixes.why: The 0.09-0.44 range spans models rejected by Delta chi2 of thousands; quoting it as 'wing-model dependent' overstates the uncertainty, and the -0.05 edge values mean the fits did not converge.
fixes.how_experts_do_it: Fit CO wing + H13CN simultaneously with a physically motivated wing (broad Gaussians, as fitted on the CO 3-2 profile elsewhere), compare models by BIC, and marginalise alpha over the accepted set.

fixes.what: Propagate the 2.2'' ratios into the X_S/X_N statement as a likelihood: give the posterior of X_S/X_N (ratio of ratios with the empirical errors, from both H13CN and H13CO+, with the HCO+/HCN opacity correction) rather than 'N-S 1.3-1.8 sigma'; and test whether the 12C 1-0 line is optically thin enough for R13/12 = 1/X (use the RADEX tau at the posterior) since this decides what the ratio means.
fixes.why: The ratio of an optically thick 12C line to a thin 13C line is not 1/X; without the tau correction (b) is a statement about line ratios only. The peak-pixel disagreement (S 0.022/0.033 vs 0.006) also needs an explicit systematic in the error.
fixes.how_experts_do_it: Use R = (1-e^-tau)/(1-e^-tau/X) from the model, fit X_N, X_S jointly in the ratio likelihood, and report the 1-D posterior of the ratio.

fixes.what: Resolve the inconsistency between the HCO+-only rows in reweight_1_0.csv (P_le30 0.16-0.23 for N_base_s1) and the summary (0.27-0.32); list per-run, per-prior numbers in the summary.
fixes.why: The summary cannot be checked against the table.

notes_for_questioner: Once the likelihood includes the 13C ratios, ask whether any 12C-line combination (HCN 4-3/1-0 with H13CN 1-0 at 2.2'') discriminates the thick-cold from the warm-thin branch; if the forecast Delta chi2 is <3, stop spending effort on this and move to an independent thermometer (Q43).
